title: 第2章 隐藏进化
novel_title: 御兽仙朝：我能设计进化形态
content_zh:
罗影背着书箱，沿着黄土路往家走。

    太阳很烈，日头有些偏西了。

    似乎【司晨金乌】今日有些钟情这里，晒得路边的草叶子都蔫蔫地卷着边。

    田埂上，一头牛和一个人，缓缓和罗影迎面而来。

    那是赵老六，和他的【拉车牛】。

    【拉车牛】有一样本事，名为【匀速】。

    无论背不背负重，他的速度都保持一致，因此...很适合拉车。

    此刻，牛背上驮着十几捆稻草，却依旧泰然无事。

    只是因为太多了，显得松松垮垮，走一步颠一下，稻草茬子掉了一路。

    赵老六瞅见罗影，扬了扬手里的鞭子，远远地喊了一嗓子：

    “影子！放学啦？”

    “赵叔。”

    罗影应了一声。

    赵老六的牛比罗家的【黑水牛】小一圈，觉醒等级也低些，只在一级挂着。

    且没有【黑水牛】的本事【润田】，经过的田地能保持湿润，省却了灌溉的功夫。

    犁地的本事，差了一大截。

    不过赵老六不在乎，他养牛就图一个能拉车。

    对他而言，【匀速】比【润田】好使多了。

    年年秋收靠这头牛把粮食从地里拖回来，够用就行。

    走过赵老六家的地头，就是村口那口老井。

    张婶蹲在井台边，袖子撸到了胳膊肘，搓着衣服。

    身旁的【洗衣狐】正甩着尾巴卷水。

    那条蓬松的大尾巴一沾水面就旋出一圈漩涡，卷起来的水又匀又细，像一条透明的绸子缠在衣裳上，清澈无比。

    这是它的本事，【净水】。

    经过他净化的水，甚至可以达到直接饮用的程度，用来洗衣效果也特别好。

    不过...张婶的这条洗衣狐，毛色不算好，灰扑扑的。

    肚皮底下还结着毛团子，一看就是没怎么打理过的。

    但张婶稀罕它。

    逢人就夸我家青儿洗得干净，好像这只洗衣狐是她闺女似的。

    张婶头也没抬，手里用力在拧着一件褂子，却不耽搁嘴皮子利索：

    “影子回来啦？”

    “你爹搁我这的那件棉袄我帮洗了，明儿赶早给你送过去。”

    “谢张婶。”

    罗影加快了两步。

    他不太想在村口多站。

    不是怕跟人说话，是怕人问。

    这阵子村里谁不知道罗家的事？

    罗长庚伤了腰，地里全靠罗川一个人扛。

    明天又是县学招考的日子...

    交不交得起那六两银子的束脩，全村人大多心里都有数。

    可谁也不好意思当面问。

    乡下人的分寸就在这里。

    知道你难，但不戳破，顶多在背后叹一句罗家那小子可惜了。

    路过刘瘸子家院墙外头的时候，一阵鸡叫从里头传出来。

    不是普通的鸡叫，是【啄虫鸡】那种短促的咯咯咯，带着一股子较劲的味道。

    紧跟着就听见刘瘸子的婆娘在里头骂：

    “又刨！又刨！菜根子都给你刨断了！”

    罗影忍不住嘴角上扬，笑了笑。

    【啄虫鸡】就这脾气，眼睛毒，爪子利。

    又有着本事【寻虫】，土地里只要有虫，都逃不过它的法眼。

    看着虫子跟遇到生死仇人一样，誓不罢休。

    而刘家那两只【啄虫鸡】尤其厉害。

    据说能精准找到藏在土里三寸深的灵虫！

    附近几家，闹了虫灾治不好的，都来借过，借完无不竖大拇指。

    可它们有个毛病，不分虫子和菜根。

    一刨起来六亲不认，殃及池鱼。

    虫子是没了...连带着刚种下去的萝卜苗子也没了。

    再往前走，过了晒谷场，就能看见罗家的院子了。

    院墙是黄土夯的，顶上搭了一层茅草。

    东边有个豁口，是去年刮大风掀的，一直没补。

    院门没有关严，只开着一点缝隙。

    罗影走到门口的时候，脚步略微停顿了一下。

    屋子里传来了一阵刻意压低的声音。

    “就一两二钱。”

    一道沉闷的声音缓缓响起。

    这是……爹的声音？

    隐约可以听到，似乎有砸吧烟嘴的声音以及深深的叹息。

    “够干什么用的？光束脩就需要六两，还有兽粮钱、灵材钱、仪式耗材等等...”

    “我知道。”

    一阵沉默。

    接着是旱烟杆子撞在床沿上的声音。

    哒、哒两下，不用想也知道，那是罗长庚在倒烟灰。

    罗影没有进去。

    站在院子外面，背着书箱。

    因为这一路的赶路，肩带已勒得肩膀生疼，可他没动，也没去扶。

    微风拂面。

    鼻头隐约嗅到一股牛粪味。

    这味道罗影闻了十四年，从来没觉得难闻，只觉得亲切。

    但今天不知怎么的，鼻子闻了，却有点发酸。

    “爹，钱的事你别操心了。”

    里面又紧接响起一道声音，比爹的粗一些，带着一股闷劲儿。

    罗影知道，这是大哥罗川的声音。

    他像是深吸了一口气，做出了一个重要的决定：

    “我明天去镇上问问，码头上扛货的活儿。

    我先干他两三个月，一切都能好起来的......”

    “你胡说啥。”

    罗长庚沙哑的声音响起，打断了他：

    “地里的活谁干？

    秋播再过半个月就到了，种子都买好了，你去扛货，地撂了？”

    “而且...你确定，你一个人类，要去和御兽扛货？

    你扛的过【载重驹】？！”

    罗川没吭声。

    过了一会儿，这才闷闷开口：

    “那......那就白天种地，晚上去码头。”

    罗长庚没接话。

    旱烟杆子又磕了两下，抽了一口。

    院子里安静了一小会儿。

    然后罗川的声音又响起来了，这回更低。

    低到罗影几乎要贴着门缝才能听清。

    “爹。
content_en:
Luo Ying carried the book box and walked home along the loess road.
The sun is very strong, and the sun is a little westward.
It seems that [Sichen Golden Crow] is a little fond of this place today, and the grass and leaves on the roadside are wilted and curled up in the sun.
On the ridge of the field, a cow and a man slowly and Luo Ying came towards them.
That was Zhao Laoliu, and his [drawing oxen].
[Drawing Oxen] There is a thing called [Constant Speed].
His speed remains consistent whether he's carrying a load or not, so... great for pulling.
At this moment, the cow was carrying more than a dozen bundles of straw on its back, but it was still calm.
Just because there are too many, they look loose and loose. Every time you take a step, the straw stubble falls all the way.
Zhao Laoliu saw Luo Ying, raised the whip in his hand, and shouted from a distance:
"Shadow! Is school out?"
"Uncle Zhao."
Luo Ying responded.
Zhao Laoliu's cow is smaller than the Luo family's [Black Buffalo], and its awakening level is also lower, only at level one.
And without the ability of [Black Buffalo] to [moisten the fields], the fields passing by can be kept moist, saving the effort of irrigation.
My ability to plow fields is far behind.
But Zhao Laoliu didn't care, he raised cattle just to be able to pull a cart.
For him, [Constant Speed] is much easier to use than [Runtian].
Every autumn harvest relies on this cow to drag grain back from the fields, which is enough.
Walking past Zhao Laoliu's home, there is the old well at the entrance of the village.
Aunt Zhang squatted by the well platform, her sleeves rolled up to her elbows, rubbing her clothes.
The [Laundry Fox] next to her was waving her tail in the water.
As soon as the big fluffy tail touches the water, it spins out a whirlpool. The water rolled up is even and thin, like a piece of transparent silk wrapped around clothes, extremely clear.
This is its ability, [water purification].
The water purified by it can even reach the level of direct drinking, and it is also very effective when used for laundry.
However... Aunt Zhang's laundry fox's coat color is not very good and is very gray.
There is still a ball of hair under the belly, which looks like it has not been taken care of.
But Aunt Zhang didn't like it.
Everyone always praises my Qing'er for her clean laundry, as if this laundry fox is her daughter.
Aunt Zhang didn't even raise her head. She was twisting a gown hard in her hand, but she didn't hesitate to speak sharply:
"Shadow is back?"
"I helped wash the cotton-padded jacket that your father left here for me and will send it to you as soon as possible tomorrow."
"Thank you Aunt Zhang."
Luo Ying took two steps faster.
He didn't really want to stand at the entrance of the village for too long.
It's not that I'm afraid of talking to people, it's that I'm afraid of being asked.
Who in the village doesn't know about the Luo family these days?
Luo Changgeng injured his waist, and Luo Chuan had to carry all the land alone.
Tomorrow is the county school recruitment exam day again...
Most people in the village knew whether they could afford Shu Xiu's sixty taels of silver.
But no one was too embarrassed to ask in person.
This is where country people have their sense of propriety.
I know it's difficult for you, but I don't expose it. At most, I sigh behind my back that it's a pity for that kid from the Luo family.
When passing by the courtyard wall of Liu Laizi's house, a rooster crowed from inside.
It's not an ordinary chicken crow, it's the short cluck of a [worm-pecking chicken], with a hint of competition.
Immediately afterwards, I heard Liu Laizi’s mother-in-law scolding inside:
"Purch again! Plow again! You've even cut off the root of the vegetable!"
Luo Ying couldn't help but raise the corners of his mouth and smiled.
[Insect Pecking Chicken] He has such a temper, poisonous eyes and sharp claws.
It also has the ability to "hunt for insects". As long as there are insects in the land, they cannot escape its detection.
Looking at bugs is like meeting an enemy of life and death, and you will never give up.
The two [insect-pecking chickens] of the Liu family are particularly powerful.
It is said that it can accurately find spiritual insects hidden three inches deep in the soil!
I borrowed it from several nearby houses that couldn't deal with insect infestations, and everyone gave me a thumbs up after borrowing it.
But there is a problem with them. They don't distinguish between bugs and roots.
As soon as it was dug up, six relatives would not be recognized, which would bring disaster to the fish in the pond.
The insects are gone...even the newly planted radish seedlings are gone.
Walking further, after passing the grain drying field, you can see the Luo family's yard.
The courtyard wall is made of rammed loess, with a layer of thatch on top.
There is a gap on the east side, which was opened by strong winds last year and has not been repaired.
The courtyard door was not closed tightly, only a small gap was left open.
When Luo Ying walked to the door, his footsteps paused slightly.
There was a deliberately low sound in the room.
"Just one or two cents."
A dull voice sounded slowly.
Is this... dad's voice?
You can vaguely hear the sound of smashing cigarette holders and deep sighs.
"What's enough for it? Just six taels for beam repair, as well as animal food money, spiritual material money, ritual consumables, etc..."
"I know."
There was silence.
Then there was the sound of the tobacco pole hitting the edge of the bed.
Click, click twice, you don't need to think about it, it's Luo Changgeng pouring out the ash.
Luo Ying did not go in.
Standing outside the yard, carrying a book box.
Because of the long journey, the straps had tightened on his shoulders, but he didn't move or help him.
The breeze blows.
My nose smelled faintly of cow dung.
Luo Ying has smelled this smell for fourteen years and has never found it unpleasant, only friendly.
But today for some reason, my nose felt a little sour when I smelled it.
"Dad, don't worry about money."
Another voice sounded from inside, thicker than dad's and with a muffled sound.
Luo Ying knew that this was the voice of his eldest brother Luo Chuan.
He seemed to take a deep breath and made an important decision:
"I'll go to town tomorrow to ask about the work of carrying goods on the dock.
I'll fuck him for two or three months first, and everything will get better..."
"What are you talking about?"
Luo Changgeng's hoarse voice interrupted him:
“Who does the work in the fields?
Autumn sowing will arrive in another half month. The seeds have been bought. You go to carry the goods, but the ground is abandoned?"
"And...are you sure that you, a human, are going to carry goods with a beast?
Have you ever been able to carry a [loaded horse]?!"
Luo Chuan said nothing.
After a while, he finally said muffledly:
"Then... then farm during the day and go to the dock at night."
Luo Changgeng didn't answer.
He knocked the dry tobacco stick twice more and took a puff.
The yard was quiet for a while.
Then Luo Chuan's voice sounded again, this time even lower.
It was so low that Luo Ying almost had to press against the crack of the door to hear clearly.
"father.
